# Sunton ESP32-8048S043 vendor documents

Kept from the vendor's support package for the 4.3" 800x480 ESP32-S3 display board:
specification, structure diagrams, driver IC datasheets, schematics and the getting
started guide, plus a third-party Arduino write-up (`ESP32-8048S043-macsbug.pdf`).

The rest of the package (Arduino demos with their own copy of LVGL, the Windows flash
tool, font tools, sample binaries) was removed from the tree on 2026-09-01. It is still
in git history (`git log --all -- '4-2.3inch_ESP32-8048S043'`) and can be downloaded
again from the vendor (search "ESP32-8048S043 Sunton" for the current link).
